name: Human Beings
overview: Scripture reveals that human beings are uniquely created in the image and likeness of God, entrusted with dominion over the earth and its creatures, as seen in Genesis 1:26-27. God personally formed man from the dust and breathed life into him, making him a living soul (Genesis 2:7). The intimate care of God in fashioning each person is further emphasized in Job 10:8 and Psalm 139:13, highlighting His sovereign design even before birth. Isaiah 13:12 underscores the immeasurable value God places on human life, declaring man more precious than fine gold.
